entries.title: Mastering React Hooks: A Deep Dive
entries.description: An in-depth article exploring advanced React Hooks patterns and best practices for building robust applications.
content: React Hooks changed how we build components forever. In this article, we explore advanced patterns such as custom hooks, useReducer for complex state, and performance optimizations with useMemo and useCallback.

We start with the fundamentals and build up to real-world scenarios: fetching data with custom hooks, managing forms, and sharing logic across components without render props or higher-order components.
By the end, you will have a mental model that lets you design your own reusable hooks and debug common pitfalls like stale closures and infinite re-render loops.

entries.title: Demystifying Microservices Architecture
entries.description: A comprehensive guide to understanding and implementing microservices, including benefits and challenges.
content: Microservices split a monolith into independently deployable services, each owning a slice of the business domain. This guide walks through the core concepts, from bounded contexts to API gateways.

We discuss when microservices actually make sense, the operational complexity they introduce (service discovery, observability, distributed transactions), and pragmatic alternatives like modular monoliths.
A practical example ties everything together: designing, containerizing, and orchestrating a small set of services with Docker and Kubernetes.

entries.title: Scaling Web Applications with PostgreSQL
entries.description: Practical strategies for scaling a PostgreSQL-backed web app: indexing, caching, connection pooling, and read replicas.
content: Before reaching for a new database, most applications can scale much further with disciplined PostgreSQL usage. This article covers index design, query analysis with EXPLAIN, and caching layers.
We explore connection pooling with PgBouncer, read replicas for analytics workloads, partitioning large tables, and vacuum maintenance that keeps performance predictable.
Each strategy comes with trade-offs and metrics you should track to know when you genuinely need the next step.

entries.title: A Practical Guide to TypeScript Type Safety
entries.description: How to get the most out of TypeScript: discriminated unions, generics, and type guards for safer code.
content: TypeScript's value shows when the types actually prevent bugs. This guide dives into discriminated unions, literal types, and user-defined type guards.
We look at practical generic patterns for building flexible yet safe APIs, and how to narrow types so runtime validation aligns with compile-time guarantees.
You will learn to avoid the 'any' escape hatch and design types that make invalid states impossible to represent.

entries.title: Building Reusable UI Components with Tailwind CSS
entries.description: Tips for creating consistent, accessible, and reusable components on top of Tailwind CSS.
content: Tailwind gives you primitives, not components. To stay consistent at scale, you need a strategy: tokens, variants, and composition.
We explore how to define design tokens, build polymorphic components with class variance, and keep accessibility baked in from the start.
The result is a lightweight component system that teams can extend without fighting the framework.
